one_liner: Sales-gated cloud helpdesk with a broad, publicly documented REST API authenticated by user-tied basic API tokens, plus an official but closed-beta MCP for Claude.

auth.notes: The documented integration method is HTTP Basic authentication: the username is the agent email and the password is an API token created by a user who has the API User permission. A narrow Public Answers read API needs no token because it returns only public content; there is no OAuth for third parties acting on behalf of users.

access.notes: Tokens are created inside an existing Gladly organization by an administrator granting the API User permission, and Gladly can enable a sandbox at https://{organization}.gladly.qa for that organization. There is no public signup, free tier, or trial. The interactive demo is a click-through product tour, not an account. Public Answers can be read without a token, but that is not general API access.

api.notes: The reference covers customers, conversations and conversation items, tasks, agents, inboxes, teams, topics, answers, endpoints, reports, webhooks, and more, with create, read, update, and delete operations. It is served publicly by ReDoc with no login.

mcp.notes: Gladly publishes the Gladly MCP for Claude, which lets Claude read and change Guides, Workflows, Actions, and AI sessions using the connecting user's permissions. It is a closed beta that Gladly must enable for the whole organization, and it requires Claude Desktop or claude.ai on a paid plan. This is separate from Gladly's MCP connections feature, which lets Gladly AI call tools on a customer's own external MCP servers. Truto also generates a third-party MCP wrapper over Gladly's REST API, but the vendor server is the one reported.

verdict.rationale: Gladly documents a broad REST API, but API tokens can only be created by an administrator inside an existing Gladly organization, and the only route to an organization is scheduling a sales call. There is no free tier, trial, or self-serve signup.

evidence.quote: Gladly API uses token-based Basic Authentication. API tokens are associated with designated Gladly users.
This API can be used without an API token because it only provides access to public content.
Our Gladly team is excited to learn more about you, your company, and the potential opportunity to partner together. Fill out the form below to schedule an introductory call.
Gladly Administrators can set API permissions on an agent-by-agent basis.
We'll enable the Gladly API in a separate sandbox environment, so you can experiment freely without impacting your production environment (or vice versa).

Clients can access the REST API via HTTPS at your organization's Gladly domain (e.g. https://{organization}.gladly.com). Resources follow REST semantics and utilize industry-standard HTTP verbs, response codes, and authentication schemes.
Some examples of what you do through Gladly APIs include managing customer profile data, interacting with a customer's timeline, providing the latest information about a customer's orders, and more.
The Gladly MCP for Claude connects Claude to your Gladly organization.
Your organization is in the beta. Gladly has enabled MCP access for your organization.
